incidents.title: European Natural Gas Prices Advance
incidents.description: European natural gas prices rose by more than 3% to above €83/MWh on Thursday, rebounding from a six-week low as geopolitical risks and concerns over tightening gas supplies continued to underpin the market. Hostilities in the Middle East escalated, while attacks on vessels near the Strait of Hormuz persisted, threatening further disruptions to LNG exports ...

incidents.title: TARA GAS Burning Off Oman as Another Tanker Attack Leaves 11 Injured
incidents.description: The LPG tanker TARA GAS remained on fire and adrift in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, according to a new navigational warning, as independently verified video showed the vessel...

incidents.title: Smaller Tankers Join Hormuz Shuttle Trade to Keep Oil Flowing
incidents.description: Oil is increasingly moving through the Strait of Hormuz on smaller vessels, helping sustain exports as attacks on supertankers squeeze availability of the ships that typically dominate the trade.

incidents.title: UAE’s ADNOC L&S Says One Crew Member Missing After Attack on Its Vessel in Hormuz
incidents.description: The United Arab Emirates' ADNOC L&S said on Wednesday that one crew member was missing and 11 injured after one of its vessels was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.
